summary: Batch #37 — Helper profile fields (photo/phone/address/id_card) + Overdue Reminders + Week Heatmap + Helper Reply Chip. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_batch37_helper_profile_and_overdue.py): 7 passed, 1 skipped (child-403 needs child auth flow not present) in ~2.5s. Verified: (a) PATCH /api/helpers/{id} persists address/phone/photo_url/id_card_url; GET /api/helpers/{id} + POST /api/helpers echo them. (b) SECURITY: GET /api/helper/me and POST /api/helper/login responses DO NOT contain 'id_card_url' (helper_public shape excludes it) — address IS present as spec allows. (c) SECURITY: a helper media token attempting GET /api/files/<parent-owned idcard path>?token=<helper media_tok> returns 404 (parent id_card is not owned by a helper/care_team message) — helper-media scoping holds. (d) POST /api/todos/nudge-overdue returns {nudged, tasks, names}; when no overdue -> {nudged:0,tasks:0,names:[]}; after seeding an OPEN task with due_date=2020-01-01 assigned to Priya -> {nudged>=1, tasks>=1, names contains 'Priya'}. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844): (1) HELPER ADD (Family -> Trusted Helpers -> +Add): 'Profile & contact' section renders with helper-photo-pick, helper-phone, helper-address, plus 'ID card copy (private) — Only the family can see this' upload (helper-idcard-pick). All 4 testIDs found. Native pickers are no-ops on web as expected. (2) HELPER DETAIL (helper/help_c77a0a30120545bb — Sunita): 'Contact & documents' card shows +91 90000 00037 + 'TEST_B37 Koramangala…, Bengaluru 560095' + an 'ID card copy' row. helper-edit-profile Edit link opens modal 'Edit profile & contact' with helper-phone/helper-address/helper-photo-pick + Replace/Remove for the existing id card (helper-idcard-pick only renders when NO id_card_url — expected). Changing phone/address and tapping profile-save PATCHes the helper and the card updates to the new values on the detail screen. HELPER PORTAL (sunita/1234) has NO helper-edit-profile UI — editing correctly restricted to parents. (3) HOME OVERDUE (after seeding 1 overdue task for Priya): 'Needs your attention' shows '1 overdue task · TEST_B37_UI_OVERDUE' card, and Family tasks header shows red banner 'task-nudge-overdue' with text '1 task overdue · Remind all'. Tapping it shows home-toast '⏰ Reminding everyone with overdue tasks…' then '⏰ Reminded Priya' (from nudge-overdue API), and disappears after ~2.6s. (4) CALENDAR WEEK HEATMAP: cal-view-week switches to 7 week-day-YYYY-MM-DD rows; each row shows date + a small count under the date (1..N) + the first event(s) with time & title (or 'No events'); rows are shaded proportional to event count; days with >=4 events show '🔥 Busy day · N events' caption (none present in demo data, threshold code confirmed at calendar.tsx:356/362); tapping cal-member-* to filter (deselecting Priya) re-shades and hides Priya's events; tapping a week row switches to Day view for that date (hero updates to 'Sun, 16 Aug'). (5) HELPER REPLY CHIP: helper-notif-btn -> Alerts feed shows Care Team rows with helper-reply-<i> 'On it 👍' chip. Tapping helper-reply-0 does NOT navigate away (URL stays on /helper-portal/notifications), the chip label immediately updates to 'Sent' (with check icon), and helper-reply-flash bottom toast shows 'Sent “On it 👍” to the Care Team'. Visiting /helper-portal/care-team confirms the 'On it 👍' message bubble now appears at the bottom of the thread. No React Native red screen, no crashes; only benign expo-notifications warnings on web and expected 401s from probing fetch injection. Regression: existing Batch #36 features (task-nudge-<item>, cal-view-day, helper-notif-<i> routing) still intact.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6395-6409 helper_public — correctly omits id_card_url from the public shape but keeps address; this is exactly what makes GET /helper/me + POST /helper/login safe. Parent-facing endpoints re-add id_card_url via `pub['id_card_url'] = h.get('id_card_url')` (6483, 6498, 6548) — clean opt-in pattern.

server.py:6508-6550 PATCH /helpers/{id} — accepts address & id_card_url via HelperPatch and strips address to null when empty (6521-6524). Response echoes id_card_url so the parent UI can show a thumbnail immediately.

server.py:2800-2853 /todos/nudge-overdue — parent-only guard (2805-2806), groups overdue by assignee, posts ONE message per assignee with up to 4 titles + '+N more' overflow, updates chats.last_message with '⏰ Overdue task reminders', best-effort push with idempotency key `overduenudge_<fid>_<yyyy-mm-ddThh>` so a double-tap in the same hour doesn't spam. Response shape matches spec.

frontend/src/components/HelperProfileFields.tsx:82-141 correctly wires testIDs helper-photo-pick, helper-phone, helper-address, helper-idcard-pick / helper-idcard-replace / helper-idcard-remove. Note the pick vs. replace duality: helper-idcard-pick only renders when there's NO existing id_card_url — testing agents should look for helper-idcard-replace on Sunita's edit modal after prior tests set a value.

frontend/app/helper/[id].tsx:310-334 Contact & documents card + helper-edit-profile edit link. Line 334 'No ID card uploaded' placeholder correctly shown only when h.id_card_url is null. profile-save on line 653 wired to a PATCH and closes the modal on success.

frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:250-262 overdueCount memo + nudgeOverdue optimistic toast: sets toast BEFORE awaiting the API so users get instant feedback, then updates the toast text with the API result. task-nudge-overdue banner is guarded by overdueCount>0 (index.tsx:661).

frontend/app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx:345-362 week-day-<ds> row: renders `heat` count + '🔥' emoji when heat>=4 + 'Busy day · N events' caption. Shading intensity is derived from a heat proportion — good UX.

frontend/app/helper-portal/notifications.tsx:57-135 — helper-reply-<i> chip posts to /helper/care-team without navigation, sets replied[i]=true so the chip becomes 'Sent', and shows helper-reply-flash bottom toast. Chip only renders for Care Team rows (kind==='care_team'), keeping handover/rating rows tap-navigate as before.
